run_main: run the main function to auto generate the providers.md documentation file
generate_providers_doc: generate a markdown documentation file listing all valid crowd provider types and their arguments
list_provider_types: list all valid provider types from the mephisto operations registry
get_provider_args: get the CLI wut arguments for a specific crowd provider type
add_args_table: add an object arguments table to a markdown file using add_object_args_table_info
